title: Wearable Quivers
description: Wearable Quivers adds equippable quivers that store multiple arrow types. Compatible with backpacks — the quiver automatically moves to your hip slot. Shoot directly from your quiver, switch arrow types with and upgrade through six tiers up to netherite.
body:
# 🏹 Wearable Quivers

  > *Carry your arrows with style. Switch types on the fly. Never fumble with your inventory mid-fight again.*

  ---

  ## ✦ What is this?

  Wearable Quivers adds craftable, equippable quivers that sit on your back (or hip when wearing a backpack). Store multiple arrow types, shoot directly from the quiver, and cycle between them without ever opening your
  inventory.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2f2dea79139ddbf3b4c315e3c8636d5dabd8a25_0.webp) ![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34072d0009970487ef4e8b96ea257a8f3f542c4f_0.webp)
  ---

  ## ✦ Features

  **📦 Arrow Storage**
  Store up to 6 different arrow types in one quiver. Fill it by right-clicking arrows onto it in your inventory.

  **🎯 Direct Shooting**
  Bows and crossbows pull from your quiver automatically, prioritizing it over your inventory.

  **🔄 Quick Switching**
  Scroll over the quiver slot in your inventory to cycle arrow types, or use **Shift + Scroll** while holding a bow — no inventory needed.

  **🖥️Arrow HUD**
  A clean slot indicator appears next to your hotbar while holding a bow, showing your current arrow, count, and the next/previous types at a glance.

  **🎨 Dyeable**
  Leather quivers can be dyed any color in a cauldron or a Crafting Table.

  ---

  ## ✦ Tiers

  Craft a leather quiver to start, then upgrade it at the smithing table.

  | Tier | Capacity |
  |------|----------|
  | 🟤 Leather | 64 |
  | 🟠 Copper | 128 |
  | ⚪ Iron | 192 |
  | 🟡 Gold | 256 |
  | 🔵 Diamond | 320 |
  | ⚫ Netherite | 384 |

  ---

  ## ✦ Backpack and Elytra Friendly

  The quiver equips in the **quiver slot**. Equip a backpack or an Elytra and the quiver shifts to your hip automatically. Take the backpack off and it moves back. No fuss.

  ---

  ## ✦ Conservation Enchantment

  Infinity is replaced with **Conservation** — a more balanced take on arrow preservation.

  - **Conservation I** — 25% chance to save the arrow
  - **Conservation II** — 50% chance to save the arrow

## ✦ Auto Refill Enchantment

  Keep your quiver topped up without lifting a finger.

  - **Auto Refill** — every second, arrows from your inventory are automatically moved into the quiver
  - Pause and resume at any time: hover over the quiver and press **T**
  - Status shown in the item tooltip — **Active** or **Inactive**

  ---

  ## ✦ Requirements

  - [Trinkets](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets)

  ## ✦ Optional Compatibility

  - [Advanced Cauldron](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-cauldron) — dye quivers in cauldrons
  - [Advanced Fletching Table](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-fletching-table) — trail colors displayed in the HUD
  - EMI / REI / JEI — smithing recipes shown in recipe viewers
